result.title: LOCUS: Causal Support Windows for Attribute Control in Autoregressive Image Generation
result.summary: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究自回归图像生成中属性干预效果的序列位置依赖性，提出「因果支持剖面」测量各窗口内 patch image-token 状态能改变渲染属性的频率，并据此将测试时 latent 优化路由到对应窗口（LOCUS）以修复多属性失败。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按窗口测量 latent 状态 patch 对输出的因果影响、并区分「结构属性靠前窄窗口、外观属性靠后宽窗口」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中干预位置与深度如何影响视觉信息的因果作用与贡献分配；但研究对象是图像生成而非 VLM 推理。
